subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) As a result his mother felt in great financial problem. (b) One day this Dukhu Mia became a great poet. (c) He is a rebel poet and our national poet. (d) You will have heard the name of Kazi Nazrul Islam. (e) Nazrul Islam was born on 20th May, 1899 at Burdwan. (f) He was called Dukhu Mia for his sorrow. (g) He spent his early life in great hardship. (h) He lost his father in his childhood.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
